checks_passed: real systemd starts the installed read-only daemon; UID 1000 connects to its production socket
sandboxed installed service exposes real per-interface network counters and sampled rates to UID 1000
running process has NoNewPrivileges, seccomp and only CAP_DAC_OVERRIDE
actual mount namespace enforces read-only system/sysfs, writable service paths, hidden home and private tmp

systemd stop removes the socket and RuntimeDirectory
systemd start/restart creates a new responding daemon

packaged experimental writer is static and never enabled by installation
packaged writer sandbox starts without an unowned fixture write
writer has a separate cgroup and only the exact fixture mode attribute is writable
killing the controller entire service cgroup leaves independent Automatic recovery alive

old controller lease cannot reapply Maximum after writer restart
normal controller service stop restores Automatic without a broad hwmon sweep
independently scheduled writer expires a stopped controller lease in the real systemd guest
package removal hook preserves its executable and refuses to discard pending recovery intent

live client rejects fixture frames and desktop users cannot impersonate or access the control telemetry endpoint
identified active NVIDIA temperature passes fixture preflight; stale/future data restores Auto and cannot rearm itself
telemetry service loss restores Automatic without widening the controller device sandbox or using a user cache
installed service sandbox admits production-polkit-authorized desktop wrapper through peer pidfd and real cgroup v2

installed sandbox restart preserves game execution and recovers Interrupted history without reapplying authority
